summary: Woman struck by rockfall on Wham Ridge of Vestal Peak at 13,200 ft and unable to descend; rare Colorado National Guard HAATS helicopter hoist (only 3rd such asset request in 10+ years) extracted her and her climbing partner to Silverton, then transferred to Mercy Regional Medical Center in Durango
